title: 海外でも家が高い　主因は外国人ではない　世界の現状、専門家が解説

translated_text: In major cities around the world, rising housing prices have become a social issue. In Japan, there are claims that real estate prices have risen due to an increase in foreigners, but is this true? How are other countries addressing the price hike? We asked Satoshi Tanaka, chief economist at Daiichi Life Asset Management Economic Research Institute, who is knowledgeable about overseas housing prices. It is one factor, but it is not the main cause. The major reasons are global rises in construction material costs, yen depreciation, and labor shortages driving up wages. In international politics, globalization is being curbed and national sovereignty is being emphasized. In economics, neoliberalism is being curbed.
